correctness.rationale: Exact first-band moments force ∫e_d=2^-d and ∫e_{d-1}=d2^{-(d-1)}. If every support point has min p_j≤s then pointwise e_{d-1}≥(s^-1+d-1)e_d; averaging forces s≥1/(d+1). The atomic replacement identity verifies all 3^d Fourier characters for every d; equality forces precisely high contact nodes or a skeleton with two antipodes; moments fix contact masses, and an explicit perturbation proves multiple extremizers. Checked normalization, boundary and zero-coordinate cases; the all-d proof is not computational enumeration.

value.rationale: A complete all-dimensional exact covering law for positive first-band multivariate Fourier quadrature is a natural sharp support-geometry invariant. The construction avoids tensor-product design, and compulsory contact weights coexist with a dimension-three transition from full rigidity to infinitely many extremizers. This is structurally meaningful beyond the known two-dimensional special case.
